geometry.partition: whole corridor rows replicated; geometry never clipped
geometry.repair: canonical geometry first, else the shared point-preserving repair ladder

semantics.area: sum of each mapped feature's own geometry clipped to the requested buffer (feature-area sum, not a spatial union)
semantics.length: sum of each mapped line feature's clipped length within the requested buffer
semantics.counts: distinct source feature ids contributing a positive clipped area or length at that buffer distance
semantics.coverage: per distance against the published source-window extent
semantics.replication: whole derived row replicated into every 0.2 degree cell its geometry intersects

metrics.wetlandDefinition: sum of each mapped feature's own geometry clipped to the requested buffer (feature-area sum, not a spatial union)
